scope: Broad discovery survey of MTG market, demand, popularity and event sources; not a claim to enumerate every website or validate every advertised data feed.

verification_legend.tested: Public structured data downloaded and inspected locally
verification_legend.documented: First-party documentation or feature page inspected; integration not tested
verification_legend.observed: First-party page or indexed first-party content inspected
verification_legend.claimed: Provider advertises capability; coverage, accuracy or rights not independently validated
verification_legend.limited: Page unavailable or only partial verification; not an integration dependency

access_rule: A documented endpoint is not proof of an open data license. Prefer published downloads and supported APIs; record terms, rates, cost and retention before implementing. No subscriptions, accounts, credentials or vendor submissions were created.

sources.name: Mana Pool
sources.access: Daily public gzip catalog; documented API; private seller endpoints require token
sources.use: Exact variant sale evidence and supply; later actual order calibration
sources.limits: Recent sales capped at 20 per variant; no sale ID or complete time window documented. Not total market volume. Zero low price can mean no stock.

sources.name: TCGplayer
sources.access: Website research; official API is closed to new applicants
sources.use: US transaction comparator and exact-SKU spot checks
sources.limits: Market Price is an aggregate, not a firm bid or complete volume series. Do not assume documented recent-sales endpoint is accessible.

sources.name: Cardmarket
sources.access: Published daily price-guide/catalog downloads; website; current help says no new API applications
sources.use: Independent European pricing and supply context; buyer geography
sources.limits: Do not treat EUR prices as US cash offers or average-price windows as volume. Official help is stricter than older professional-seller API documentation.

sources.name: eBay Product Research
sources.access: Seller Hub research; account eligibility applies; Marketplace Insights API closed to new users
sources.use: Premium, unusual treatment and collector comps
sources.limits: Query/title contamination, lots, condition, accepted offers and shipping require review. Research offers up to three years; reported sell-through only for eligible recent windows. No automatic market-wide API assumed. Preserve search filters, date window and raw condition category. Do not map eBay Very Good to MTG grades automatically. Listing averages plus last-sold dates are not individual transactions. Empty search results are not evidence of no market activity.
sources.integration_status: Potential resource: Seller Hub browser pilot tested; scalable historical ingestion not established; no accepted canonical eBay market observations.
sources.verification_detail: Authenticated Product Research pilot inspected Daze SOA 80, Prismatic Ending SOA 72 and Island SLP 32. Raw captures retained privately. Search result rows may aggregate multiple sales.

sources.name: CardTrader
sources.access: Documented account-token API
sources.use: Independent supply/asking-price comparison, international buyer context
sources.limits: API listings are not completed market sales; direct and Zero fulfillment economics differ; preserve currency and seller region.

sources.name: Cardsphere
sources.access: Website/account workflow; no bulk market API verified
sources.upstream: Cardsphere offers; index combines other providers
sources.use: Bid-side demand and an alternative channel where batch economics work
sources.limits: Offers are not completed sales; fees, shipping and cash withdrawal reduce realizable cash. Index starts with NM English and models other conditions/languages.

sources.name: Card Kingdom
sources.access: Direct buylist and CSV cart import; retained TCGSentry export
sources.use: Practical dealer baseline; buying depth
sources.limits: NM quote and quantity are conditional; English acceptance and thresholds matter. Do not assume undocumented endpoints are supported integration contracts.

sources.name: Star City Games
sources.access: Direct sell list, CSV workflow, existing TCGSentry export
sources.use: Second dealer comparator and event candidate after attendance verification
sources.limits: Capacity unknown in current export; approval and grade are separate. An old event article does not verify the next event.

sources.name: ABU Games
sources.access: Public buylist UI
sources.use: Additional bid competition and played-card options
sources.limits: Cash and trade prices differ materially; do not rank store credit as cash. Integration not tested.

sources.name: CoolStuffInc
sources.access: Public sell list and approval workflow
sources.use: Additional dealer offers when incremental postage is justified
sources.limits: Cash versus credit distinct; bulk language/condition restrictions; final approval needed.

sources.name: Strike Zone
sources.access: Listed by current comparison providers; direct current workflow not verified in this survey
sources.use: Additional bid candidate if direct verification finds worthwhile coverage
sources.limits: Do not rely on old buylisting articles or aggregator quantities without checking the dealer.

sources.name: Card Conduit
sources.access: Public estimate/service information; collection upload not performed
sources.upstream: Partner buylists and Card Conduit model
sources.use: Low-effort service baseline against doing our own splitting
sources.limits: Estimated prices are not locked until processing. Service fees and preparation differ. Marketing average uplift is not a forecast for this collection.

sources.name: Three for One Trading
sources.access: Event pages and optional quote/appointment workflow; no contact made
sources.use: Event-specific desirability and quote workflow
sources.limits: Atlanta November 13–15, 2026 buying page and organizer listing verified. Estimates remain conditional on identity, grade, capacity and final quote; specialist interest is not a guaranteed premium.

sources.name: Face to Face Games
sources.access: Public event hotlist and sell-card pages
sources.use: Specific buyer demand and event shortlist
sources.limits: Hotlist cards are partly images; confirm identity, currency, event and update date. Prices may change without notice. Atlanta directory lists Jeux Face a Face; generic hotlist is not yet validated as Atlanta-specific.

sources.name: Hareruya
sources.access: Public Japanese purchase pages linked by official site
sources.use: Japanese/collector-printing context and specialist comparisons
sources.limits: JPY and regional terms; not automatically a US sell channel or confirmed event buyer. Expired campaigns are not current bonuses.

sources.name: Grey Ogre Games
sources.access: Public store buying page
sources.upstream: Grey Ogre; some pricing explicitly based on CK
sources.use: Regional demand example and buyer-specific constraints
sources.limits: Not an independent CK price corroboration. Store buying status is not event attendance or global demand.

sources.name: MagicCon official event sites
sources.access: Public event-specific pages
sources.use: Establish actual vendor universe before optimizing a route
sources.limits: Exhibitor does not necessarily buy. Current directory contains a ManaTrust heading with Pro-Play copy and shared booth numbers; verify dealer identity and final routing.

sources.name: Tales of Adventure / TOAMagic
sources.access: Listed as TOAMagic in current Atlanta organizer directory; direct site fetch unavailable
sources.use: Potential Atlanta quote comparison
sources.limits: Attendance listing observed; current buying policy and usable structured price feed not validated.

sources.name: Ninety Five / 95MTG
sources.access: Direct site fetch unavailable in this survey
sources.use: Check only if confirmed on target event roster
sources.limits: No current price feed, buying policy or attendance validated; old community mentions are insufficient.

sources.name: Scryfall
sources.access: Documented API and bulk files; existing bulk retained
sources.upstream: Scryfall catalog; prices/ranks supplied by named external providers
sources.use: Identity and crosswalk backbone
sources.limits: Reference prices and popularity ranks are not new independent observations; default-language scope and stale bulk prices matter.

sources.name: MTGJSON
sources.access: Public compressed bulk; AllPrices covers past 90 days, AllPricesToday current day
sources.upstream: Multiple catalog and price providers, retained separately
sources.use: Reproducible daily price history and provider-ID joins
sources.limits: Price history is not transaction history or complete volume. Keep paper/MTGO separate; optional providers can be absent.

sources.name: TCGCSV
sources.access: Public JSON/CSV; once daily, custom user agent, documented throttling
sources.use: Alternative delivery of TCGplayer reference pricing
sources.limits: Same underlying marketplace as TCGplayer; not a sales-volume API. Avoid redundant full refreshes.

sources.name: TCGSentry
sources.access: Existing authenticated collection and CSV export
sources.upstream: CK, SCG, Mana Pool and source-specific model
sources.use: Convenient repeatable dealer capture; source model is a comparison hypothesis
sources.limits: Not physical inventory truth; no independent sales sample. Modeled net omits order costs and old-high logic does not establish recovery.

sources.name: MTGStocks
sources.access: Public browser pages; premium features; bulk integration not verified
sources.upstream: TCGplayer and other named price providers
sources.use: Detect anomalies and investigate treatment-specific trends
sources.limits: Interests means price movement, not wishlist counts or popularity. Listing tabs and market tabs must not be mixed.

sources.name: MTGGoldfish
sources.access: Public pages; premium per-card price-history CSV advertised
sources.upstream: Named price vendors and tournament/deck sources
sources.use: Format demand context plus convenient historical reference
sources.limits: Tournament sample is not population census; price-history CSV is not sales history. Paid export not purchased.

sources.name: Quiet Speculation Trader Tools
sources.access: Public limited views; merchant/quantity values hidden in inspected page
sources.use: Comparator for dealer coverage; possible paid convenience
sources.limits: Do not rely on decade-old articles for current automation or merchant coverage. Underlying bids must be rechecked.

sources.name: MTGBAN
sources.access: Public limited pages; login/paid export prompts observed
sources.use: Broader buylist discovery and outlier checking
sources.limits: Source-specific scopes and access tiers must be checked; aggregate estimates are not guaranteed execution.

sources.name: MTGPrice
sources.access: Public and paid ProTrader features advertised
sources.use: Historical inventory-context lead and hypotheses
sources.limits: Freshness and actual per-card coverage require testing; marketing arbitrage claims are not evidence of realizable profit.

sources.name: EchoMTG
sources.access: Account API and subscription tiers; current terms restrict external reuse
sources.use: Potential reference UI, not a default engine backend
sources.limits: API existence does not grant unrestricted repurposing; endpoint and permitted personal-app use need clarification before integration.

sources.name: PriceCharting
sources.access: Public card pages; paid API/CSV
sources.use: Collector comps with exact-title review
sources.limits: API explicitly excludes historical prices and historical sales; treatment contamination already found. Annual volume is not current velocity.

sources.name: 130 Point
sources.access: Free research UI; no supported bulk API verified
sources.upstream: eBay, Heritage, Goldin and other marketplaces
sources.use: Premium-printing and unusual-card spot checks
sources.limits: Duplicates underlying marketplace events; title and lot filtering required.

sources.name: Card Ladder
sources.access: Free limited tools; sales history in paid Pro
sources.use: Escalation for valuable collector pieces if free evidence fails
sources.limits: Magic exact-printing coverage not tested; graded market differs from raw play copies; no subscription purchased.

sources.name: Heritage Auctions
sources.access: Public sold archive; detail access may vary
sources.use: Rare, graded, artist-proof and exceptional items
sources.limits: Match grade/provenance and distinguish buyer premium from seller proceeds. Ordinary singles need different comparators.

sources.name: PSA Auction Prices / Population
sources.access: Public product/grade pages
sources.use: Graded comparators only when relevant
sources.limits: Graded population is neither print run nor actively available stock. Raw NM cannot be valued as a numerical grade.

sources.name: EDHREC
sources.access: Public pages; supported bulk/API route not verified
sources.upstream: Archidekt, Moxfield, Scryfall deck data per FAQ
sources.use: Commander demand at card/oracle level
sources.limits: Deck inclusion is not purchases or exact-printing demand. Updated deck populations and eligibility affect denominators; avoid double-counting source sites.

sources.name: MTGTop8
sources.access: Public search and event pages
sources.use: Competitive staple demand and event context
sources.limits: Selected/reported results bias sample; event overlap with other aggregators; no market transactions.

sources.name: MTGDecks
sources.access: Public pages; no supported bulk route verified
sources.use: Cross-check competitive adoption by format
sources.limits: Deduplicate events against Goldfish/Top8; web sample is not paper ownership or sales.

sources.name: EDHTop16
sources.access: Public filtered pages
sources.use: Competitive Commander demand and buyer fit
sources.limits: Conversion is tournament success, not sales conversion. Minimum entries, time window and event size are necessary context.

sources.name: TopDeck.gg
sources.access: Documented free API key; attribution and rate limits required
sources.use: Structured tournament input if it adds independent coverage
sources.limits: Public visibility rules apply; no private player contact fields needed. Tournament usage does not identify preferred printing.

sources.name: Melee
sources.access: Event-specific public pages; general data API not verified
sources.use: Primary event cross-check when a relevant tournament publishes records
sources.limits: Coverage and visibility vary; no unrestricted bulk capability established.

sources.name: Magic Online decklists
sources.access: Official public decklist downloads
sources.use: Primary competitive adoption signal
sources.limits: Digital play sample; never import ticket prices as paper USD or assume every listed deck represents a new purchase.

sources.name: Magic.gg / official coverage
sources.access: Public coverage articles and event pages
sources.use: Explain tournament-driven demand with known denominators
sources.limits: Published events are not all play. Separate mirror/byes/draw handling and event date; no automatic sales effect.

sources.name: Deckbox
sources.access: Public card pages
sources.upstream: Deckbox users plus named external prices
sources.use: Distinct expressed-interest proxy and supply of trade copies
sources.limits: Stale/nonfunded wishes are not bids; counts can have different printing/card scopes; no time window means no velocity.

sources.name: Moxfield and Archidekt
sources.access: Public deck pages and user exports; general approved aggregation API not established here
sources.use: Explain specific deck context when needed
sources.limits: Do not count alongside EDHREC as independent popularity; deck versions, proxies and aspirational lists differ from purchases.

sources.name: 17Lands
sources.access: Public anonymized datasets under stated attribution license
sources.use: Narrow new-set research context
sources.limits: Limited performance is not constructed demand, premium appeal or paper-card velocity; not a core feature for this tranche.

sources.name: Wizards announcements
sources.access: Official articles and product announcements
sources.use: Dated catalyst and downside evidence
sources.limits: Announcement is factual; price impact remains a hypothesis. Always check the latest effective announcement rather than a cached prior one.

sources.name: SpellBook Finance
sources.access: Advertised free keyless signals API and RSS
sources.upstream: Provider market-history snapshots and named marketplaces
sources.use: Low-cost alert/research trigger if sample quality passes
sources.limits: Signals are derived, not independent transactions. Broad sold-price claims need exact variant/lineage testing; ATH alone is not a hold reason.

sources.name: ValueMyCard
sources.access: Free history UI; comparison page places completed sales in Pro
sources.use: Possible convenient long-history reference
sources.limits: Do not interpret broad free-data wording as free completed-sales access. API, quality and exact treatment coverage untested.

sources.name: TCGAPIs
sources.access: Documented commercial tiers; sales endpoints Business+
sources.upstream: TCGplayer and other named marketplaces; third-party provider
sources.use: Potential solution if documented full-window volume remains unavailable
sources.limits: Advertised recent feed is capped; historic archive uses buckets. Verify completeness, units, shipping and reuse rights using samples before any purchase.

sources.name: TCGGraph
sources.access: Commercial REST/GraphQL service advertised
sources.upstream: CK, TCGplayer, Cardmarket, Mana Pool and other named feeds
sources.use: Possible convenience delivery layer
sources.limits: Not independent market evidence; quote capacity and exact identity still need validation. No need to pay just to duplicate free feed history.

sources.name: Mythic Index
sources.access: Advertised account-key API and up to 365-day history
sources.use: Potential price-history delivery alternative
sources.limits: No authentication or response testing performed; actual rights/availability need verification. Cardhoarder digital prices must remain separate.

sources.name: YesTCG
sources.access: Public explanation; optimizer advertised in paid Pro
sources.upstream: CK, SCG, ABU, CSI, Strike Zone
sources.use: Compare proposed batch optimizer against an existing tool
sources.limits: NM assumptions and sample postage are not this owner's costs. Reported sample uplift is not a universal result; no collection upload performed.

sources.name: ManaRite
sources.access: Indexed provider description; live fetch failed
sources.upstream: Claims CK, ABU, CSI and TCGplayer
sources.use: Track as an alternate buylist-comparison lead
sources.limits: Do not make it a dependency until availability, freshness and access are verified.

sources.name: OtterDex
sources.access: Earlier same-day browser check returned paused deployment
sources.use: Preserve old assertion only
sources.limits: Unavailable source; cannot currently refresh or substantiate the prior rising-price claim.

sources.name: Third-party Cardmarket-branded API services
sources.access: API-key commercial services; separate from Cardmarket
sources.use: Fallback candidates only if official downloads are insufficient
sources.limits: Domain names do not establish official affiliation or data rights; validate actual provenance and coverage before relying on them.

sources.name: Additional Atlanta exhibitors / dealer discovery
sources.access: Current public organizer directory
sources.use: Pro-Play Games, Propaganda, Collector Legion, Hotsauce Games, Good Games, Journey’s End Games, Nerd Gear Gaming, Pink Bunny Games, The Mana Vault MKE and others form a wider quote-discovery pool.
sources.limits: Not each dealer’s direct data feed or buying policy tested. Directory presence does not establish a cash bid. ManaTrust/Pro-Play description conflict retained.

event_context.status: owner city/month; year/date resolved from current organizer page
event_context.directory_caution: ManaTrust entry contains Pro-Play description; some booth numbers shared. Confirm details before routing.

synthesis_rules: Count independent upstream evidence, not the number of websites repeating it.
Separate executable cash bids, completed sales, asking prices, derived reference indices and play-interest proxies.
Compare USD US-market evidence with exact printing, finish, language and grade scope; retain unmatched candidates outside accepted valuations.
Store observed date separately from capture date, plus source, original identity, units, shipping, time window, filters and sample completeness.
Preserve conflicts; explain their economic implications instead of averaging unlike measures.
Dealer capacity must cover the proposed quantity; shared product capacity must not be allocated twice.
Use repeated comparable sales and supply evidence to assess higher-price opportunities; compare worthwhile net dollars after costs.
Hold requires a positive forward case and a condition for reassessment; past highs alone do not justify it.
